answer.answerText: No. ADR-043 did not cause the specific ExecutionConfiguration refactor; Story 0042 added TradingCalculatorService wiring to support exit settlement and realized PnL. ADR-043 was related context but explicitly excluded PAPER EXIT implementation.

claims.text: The ExecutionConfiguration change injected TradingCalculatorService into PaperSettlementService.
Story 0042 identifies explicit EXIT handling, local settlement, and realized PnL as the implementation drivers.
ADR-043 explicitly excludes PAPER EXIT implementation from its scope.
ADR-043 informed account identity and execution-mode constraints, but the evidence does not establish it as the cause of this specific configuration refactor.

evidence.excerpt: The Story 0042 commit changes PaperSettlementService wiring by adding TradingCalculatorService to its bean factory and constructor.
Story 0042 implemented explicit ENTRY/EXIT purposes, PAPER local close dispatch, local exit settlement, and realized PnL using the existing calculator.
PaperSettlementService branches on explicit purpose and the EXIT path computes gross PnL with TradingCalculatorService.
ADR-043 states that PAPER position-query implementation, PAPER EXIT implementation, and PAPER realized-PnL settlement are not decided or implemented by the ADR.
